description: Illinois Tool Works Inc. was founded in 1912 and incorporated in 1915, and is a global manufacturer of a diversified range of industrial products and equipment with 88 divisions in 49 countries, employing approximately 43,000 people as of December 31, 2025, with its ticker symbol ITW. Its operations are organized and managed based on similar product offerings and end markets, and are reported to senior management as seven segments: Automotive OEM, a global, niche supplier to top tier OEMs providing unique innovation to address pain points for sophisticated customers with complex problems, whose businesses produce components and fasteners for automotive-related applications; Food Equipment; Test & Measurement and Electronics; Welding; Polymers & Fluids; Construction Products; and Specialty Products.
